vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component defines the strongly-typed enumeration `FaceWinding` to manage geometric orientation conventions in 3D rendering. It encapsulates the two fundamental winding orders: CounterClockwise (CCW) and Clockwise (CW). Its primary role is to provide a canonical, type-safe constant for rendering pipelines, ensuring consistency with underlying graphics APIs like WebGL. It acts as a low-level configuration constant for vertex ordering.
